rationale: The message reports completed probe results about YAML behavior, listing observed conversions and edge cases. It is delivering findings rather than asking or coordinating.

evidence.text: YAML probes: empty input outputs empty; null => `null\n`; plain true\nfalse treated scalar "true false"; yes/no strings; dates become ISO `2020-01-01T00:00:00Z`; 0x10 numeric; block | preserves trailing newline; anchors resolve; inf/-inf/NaN stringify by default.
